title: Kestrel and the Promise
author: Casper Amberdale
blurb: Zephyrine Amberdale, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
